newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Northwest Airlines in Internet ticket sale.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines in Internet ticket sale.

text.p: Northwest Airlines, Inc, will sell heavily discounted tickets in Singapore through the Internet from Friday, a company statement said.
It said the fares, with up to 45 percent off Northwest's lowest fares to the United States, are available on specific flights from Singapore to New York and to San Francisco.
Northwest said in the statement its CyberSaver sale was the first time an airline in Asia has used the Internet to sell seats.

"Airline seats are highly perishable and it behoves airlines to find new ways to sell extra inventories in a quick and efficient manner - the Internet fulfils this need perfectly," Northwest's Singapore-based Regional Managing Director for Southeast Asia and Greater China, Jim Reinnoldt, said in a news release.
The CyberSaver Sale will be launched on the Pacific Internet Home Page. Pacific Internet is one of Singapore's three Internet service providers.
The Northwest statement said a limited number of seats are available and would be confirmed on a first-come, first-served basis. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
